title: Guess the Country by Its Shape 🔴 LIVE – type it in chat!
description:
🗺️ Guess the country by its shape and type it in the LIVE CHAT – 24/7!
🌍 Every round shows the outline of a country. Stuck? Hints unlock over time: the continent, a world map with a dot, then the capital – and letters appear one by one. The flag is revealed at the end.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Look at the shape.
2. Type the country in the chat. The stream runs a few seconds behind, so just type when you know it.
3. Everyone who's right scores: 1st = 10, 2nd = 7, 3rd = 5, everyone else 3 points.
4. Type ! and your country (e.g. !germany) to get your flag next to your name.

🏆 TOP PLAYERS TODAY: the best guessers of the day, live on screen.
🧩 More live games (Guess the Capital of the Country, Guess the Word by Emoji): youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/streams

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).
Be kind in the chat – names are shown on stream.

#guessthecountry #geographyquiz #livestream
chatHint: 🗺️ Know the country? Type its name in the chat – everyone who's right scores! Add your flag with ! + your country (e.g. !brazil).
